WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref AS site_code,
    st.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval
)
SELECT
  site_code,
  risk_evaluation_status,
  avg_compression_ratio,
  scan_count,
  scan_count::double precision / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC
LIMIT 10;
